symptom: Official PR CI #40080644535 failed two newly added synthetic correction-chain tests because their settlementRevisionId proof references still named the original provisional revision after a FINAL revision was appended. The existing UNBOUND_PROOF_REFS gate fired before the new per-revision anchor-window assertion; this was a test fixture error, not a regression of the trust-policy validator.
lesson: A synthetic correction-chain test must keep the terminal proof-reference identity synchronized with the final revision. Otherwise an earlier fail-closed proof binding masks the intended later validator branch and yields a misleading failure attribution.
guardrail: When a trust-policy fixture appends a settlement revision, update proofRefs.settlementRevisionId to the new terminal revision before asserting downstream key-window behavior. Verify the first blocker against the intended boundary, and inspect full official CI logs to distinguish fixture mismatch from implementation failure.
